entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I placed a while back. It's for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number please?
Sure, the name is Maria Jenkins, and the order number is VF881-209.

Thank you, Maria. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It works perfectly fine. To be honest, I just **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy** after the holidays, and I just **don't use it** as much as I thought I would.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that. Let me just pull up the return eligibility for your order. One moment.

Okay, thanks. I know it's been about 40 days, so I'm not sure what the policy is. If a full refund is off the table, would a partial store credit be an option? I just don't want to be completely out the money for something I'm not using. I'd even consider a **resale** if that's a possibility.
No need to worry about that, Maria. I've just checked our policy, and it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? That's great news. I was prepared for a whole negotiation. Thank you!

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return process. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. Simple enough. Thanks again for your help, David.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a good one!
You too, Maria. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
